description: This file defines a React component for a user registration page in a Next.js application. It handles user input, form submission, and displays success or error messages via toast notifications.

classes.name: RegisterPage
classes.description: React functional component rendering a registration form with input validation and toast notifications.

methods.name: onSubmit
methods.description: Handles form submission, interacts with registerAction to register a user, manages loading/error states, and triggers toast notifications based on success or failure.
